story.title: Story 2: Chunk Assembly From Turn Projections

result.planSummary: Locked Story 2’s shared conversation-transcript contract into chunk state, proved the remaining transcript-source TCs in chunk-service coverage, and updated downstream PI/workbench lifecycle tests to align with legacy placeholder lower-band blocking and canonical chunk expectations.

changedFiles.reason: Added an explicit helper for the ready conversation-only chunk transcript so lower-band consumers share one authoritative source separate from smooth text.
Bound the Story 2 contract tests to the explicit transcript-source helper and kept chunk assembly coverage aligned with projection-count and transcript behavior.
Updated PI-target expectations so legacy placeholder lower-band output is blocked instead of emitted once Story 2 legacy blocking applies.
Kept thread-view builder coverage compiling and aligned with canonical/legacy lower-band selection behavior under Story 2.
Adjusted lifecycle integration expectations to use canonical closed chunks where success is required and to expect blocking for stale legacy placeholder lower-band state.
Updated workbench lower-band readiness coverage to inspect canonical chunk readiness without treating legacy placeholder chunks as eligible output.

gatesRun.command: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern 'prepare smart compact catches up missing deterministic components|prepare refreshes canonical chunk transcript and smooth text after component source changes|strict blocks legacy lower-band selection even when stale placeholder provenance is present' tests/commands/smart-compact-lifecycle.integration.test.ts

findingsFixed: Made the shared conversation-only transcript an explicit chunk-state contract so detailed/brief source expectations are testable and future-safe.
Removed remaining placeholder-era test assumptions in PI/workbench lifecycle coverage so Story 2 legacy blocking no longer fails the story gate.

result.recommendedNextStep: Hand Story 2 to verification, then continue with Story 3 lower-band compression using the shared conversationTranscript contract as the detailed/brief input source.
